tasks.partName: Đọc to đoạn văn (Read a Text Aloud)
tasks.prompt: Read the text aloud. You will be evaluated on pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm.
tasks.textToRead: Are you out of work or looking for a better job? Well get ready, because Willis & Ryan Manufacturing has over twenty open positions at its Brownsville factory. Individuals with experience in electrical engineering, equipment maintenance, and sales are encouraged to apply. Simply call Heather Rodriguez in our Human Resources office to schedule an interview. The number is 543-7607. Good luck!

tasks.partName: Miêu tả bức tranh (Describe a Picture)
tasks.prompt: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as possible.

photos.imageDescription: Miêu tả bức tranh chi tiết về bối cảnh, con người, hành động và các chi tiết phụ.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: In this photograph, we observe an active and well-illuminated setting. In the foreground, people are focused on their individual tasks while interacting productively. In the middle ground, essential tools and work materials are neatly arranged across the table. In the background, the architectural background and natural lighting establish a modern and organized atmosphere. Overall, the entire scene conveys a strong sense of teamwork and efficiency.

tasks.partName: Trả lời câu hỏi tình huống (Respond to Questions)
tasks.scenario: Imagine that an American marketing firm is doing research in your country. You have agreed to participate in a telephone interview about bookstores.

questions.question: How many books do you read a month, and where do you usually buy them?
questions.modelAnswer: I read about two to three books every month, and I usually purchase them from online retailers because of great discounts and fast delivery.

questions.question: How often do you visit bookstores, and what do you usually do there?
questions.modelAnswer: I visit bookstores about once or twice a month to browse new releases in the personal finance and psychology sections.

questions.question: How do you think bookstores can improve their services?
questions.modelAnswer: Bookstores could improve their services by setting up quiet reading lounges with comfortable chairs and hosting regular author book-signing events.

tasks.partName: Trả lời theo thông tin cho sẵn (Respond using Information Provided)
tasks.scenario: Bạn sẽ nhận được một lịch trình/thông tin công việc và trả lời 3 câu hỏi liên quan.
tasks.scheduleText:
Respond to Questions Using the Information Provided
Hello. My name is William Ryder and I booked my flights through your agency. You sent me a copy of my itinerary but I seem to have misplaced it. I can’t find it anywhere! So, I need to ask you a couple of questions about my trip.
Question 8: Could you tell me what time I will arrive in London and how long the flight will take?
Question 9: I might need to change my plans at the last minute. I can cancel the tickets and still get a refund right?
Question 10: Some of the flights are likely to be long, so I’m worried about being uncomfortable. What class will I be flying for each leg of the trip?
tasks.scheduleHtml:
Respond to Questions Using the Information Provided

Hello. My name is William Ryder and I booked my flights through your agency. You sent me a copy of my itinerary but I seem to have misplaced it. I can’t find it anywhere! So, I need to ask you a couple of questions about my trip.

Question 8: Could you tell me what time I will arrive in London and how long the flight will take?

Question 9: I might need to change my plans at the last minute. I can cancel the tickets and still get a refund right?

Question 10: Some of the flights are likely to be long, so I’m worried about being uncomfortable. What class will I be flying for each leg of the trip?

tasks.partName: Trình bày quan điểm (Express an Opinion)
tasks.prompt: Would you rather shop online or go to the store? Give reasons and examples to express your shopping preference.
tasks.sampleBand8Answer: I firmly support this stance for two key reasons. First, this approach grants individuals significant flexibility and helps reduce daily cognitive fatigue. Second, having such balanced conditions promotes sustained motivation and superior long-term performance. Therefore, I believe this is unquestionably the most effective choice.
